review.why: Sets up an isolated git workspace for feature work: detect an existing one, ask consent, prefer native tools, fall back to manual worktrees.
review.summary: Step 0 checks whether the session is already in a linked worktree, with a guard against submodules. If not, it asks consent before creating one. Step 1 prefers the platform's native worktree tool and only then falls back to git worktree with directory selection rules. Its principle is to detect isolation first and never fight the harness.
strengths: Submodule guard avoids a common false detection
Asks consent and honors a declared preference
Prefers native harness tools to avoid phantom state
cautions: Later setup and cleanup steps were not read in full
Adds a consent question for small tasks
